overview: This gem is presented by Silent Hall of Fame. Please visit https://silent-hall-of-fame.org/ to support our non-profit mission and the legacy of silent movie stars by making a tax deductible contribution. FEEL FREE TO FOLLOW US ON TWITTER @SilentFilmGems "Cops" is a short comedy, starring Buster Keaton and featuring Joe Roberts, a star of Silent Hall of Fame. The film is full of hilarious moments and demonstrates Buster Keaton's extraordinary athletic abilities. "Cops" was added to the National Film Registry in 1997 as being deemed "culturally, historically, or aesthetically significant". Directed by Eddie Cline, Buster Keaton Produced by Joseph Schenck Scenario by Eddie Cline, Buster Keaton Starring Buster Keaton, Joe Roberts, Virginia Fox Cinematography Elgin Lessley Distributed by First National Pictures Inc. Release date March, 1922 Running time 18 min.
